_source: Blank application forms supplied by the Office of the Municipal Engineer / Office of the Building Official (Sept 2026 batch, re-uploaded 2026-11-16). Originals under lgu/assets/contents/forms/.
_note: Downloadable blank forms, rendered on services.html under the 'Forms & Permits' tab. These are BLANK APPLICATION FORMS, not filled documents and not Full Disclosure records — they do not belong in transparency.json. The procedure, requirements, fees and processing time for each permit live in citizens-charter.json (Charter pp. 64-67) and are NOT restated here, so the two can never drift. 'calatravaBranded' false means a national NBC form with a blank LGU header, which is normal and correct: the applicant writes in the municipality.
_pending: Only Engineering/OBO forms exist so far. BPLO business-permit forms, MSWDO application forms and MCR civil-registry forms have not been supplied — add groups here as they arrive rather than inventing placeholders.

groups.office: Office of the Municipal Engineer / Office of the Building Official
groups.title: Building & occupancy
groups.intro: Start here. The unified forms cover the main application; the National Building Code forms below are the ancillary permits filed with it.

forms.title: Unified Application Form for Building Permit
forms.description: The main application for a new building permit, renewal or amendment. Also serves as the application for Locational Clearance and Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance.
forms.note: Corrected 2026-11-16. The LGU's copy carried the superseded 'CEBU' from the form it was adapted from, in three places: twice in the header, hidden under the Calatrava/Romblon overlays, and ONCE VISIBLY on the Location of Construction line, which printed as 'CITY/ MUNICIPALITY OF CEBU'. All three text objects were removed from the page's content stream; the line now prints blank for the applicant to fill in. Verified: no 'CEBU' remains in the text layer, and the two rendered pages are pixel-identical to the original apart from that one line. If the LGU ever re-sends this form, re-check it - their copy is still the uncorrected one.

forms.title: Unified Application Form for Certificate of Occupancy
forms.description: Filed once the building is complete, before it may be occupied, or when the owner changes the required occupancy.

groups.office: Office of the Municipal Engineer / Office of the Building Official
groups.title: Ancillary permits (National Building Code)
groups.intro: Filed alongside the building permit. Which of these you need depends on the scope of work — your architect or civil engineer will advise.

forms.title: Architectural Permit
forms.description: Architectural works, signed and sealed by the architect.

forms.title: Civil/Structural Permit
forms.description: Structural works, signed and sealed by the civil engineer.

forms.title: Electrical Permit
forms.description: Electrical installation, signed and sealed by the electrical engineer.

forms.title: Plumbing Permit
forms.description: Plumbing and sanitary installation, signed and sealed by the sanitary engineer or master plumber.

forms.title: Electronics Permit
forms.description: Electronics installation, signed and sealed by the electronics engineer.

forms.title: Demolition Permit
forms.description: Demolition of an existing structure or part of one.

forms.title: Excavation and Ground Preparation Permit
forms.description: Excavation and fills, foundations and retaining walls, pile foundations, grading and earthworks.
forms.note: The LGU supplied two copies of this form, a Calatrava-branded one and a generic one. Only the branded copy is published, so applicants are not offered a choice between identical forms.

forms.title: Raising Permit
forms.description: Raising an existing building or structure.

forms.title: Repair Permit
forms.description: Repair works on an existing building or structure.

_corrections: lgu/assets/contents/forms/Unified-Application-for-Building-Permit.pdf is the only published file this repo has modified rather than passed through unchanged. Everything else under lgu/assets/contents/ is exactly as the LGU supplied it. The edit removed three 'CEBU' text objects; the method and the before/after verification are in MEMORY.md.
